items.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans

items.summary: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was ...

items.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning

items.summary: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to th...
items.summary_cn: 人类有目的地探索陌生空间，决定在哪里观察，直到收集到解决空间问题所需的证据。然而，视觉-语言模型（VLM）在经过精心挑选的图像和视频上推理能力越来越强，但当证据没有直接提供给它们时，它们是否也能在空间中进行搜索呢？...
